messages:
sam (oncall): apiserver 503 spike in eu-north1 since ~1718236400, provisioner attach backlog growing, lots of etcd WAL fsync warnings.
nina (infra): seeing nvme iowait and `fsync` latencies on etcd-0. attaching `iostat -x` now, and grabbing dmesg.
omar (platform): controller-manager leader election churned once at 1718236421, but leader stayed; still a lot of short-lived pod creates from GPU onboarding.
sam (oncall): paste of key logs:
```
2024-05-10T08:20:03Z etcdserver: wal sync took 890ms
2024-05-10T08:20:04Z apiserver: response 503 POST /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods
2024-05-10T08:20:05Z provisioner: queued attach instance-gpu-11
```
nina (infra): quick mitigation: lower provisioner max_concurrent_attaches from 80 to 25 in eu-north1; canary applied to infra-configmap.
omar (platform): also added 3 apiserver replicas (temp) to spread fd and client load. routing fallback for /metrics -> eu-west1 for 10m.
sam (oncall): immediate error rate down ~55% in 60s. need follow-ups: repro load in staging, run fio on etcd WAL disk, consider moving WAL to dedicated io-optimized volume.
nina (infra): opening INF-4899 for storage perf testing and WAL placement. tagging storage and provisioning.
omar (platform): short-term: add 100-200ms jitter in onboarding controller and reduce create burst by windowing.
sam (oncall): leaving monitoring, will update if regresses. dev-bot: incident INC-2024-1189 created and assigned to eng-sre. :rocket:
